items.name: suspension-span
items.text: a great suspension bridge, main cables swooping between riveted towers, the red-painted deck dissolving into sea fog

items.name: roman-aqueduct
items.text: a tiered Roman aqueduct striding a river valley, weathered arches stacked two deep, each span framing its own piece of sky

items.name: railway-viaduct
items.text: a curved stone railway viaduct crossing open moorland, tapered piers rooted in heather, arches echoing away to the far bank

items.name: radio-telescope
items.text: a giant radio telescope, white dish tilted at the sky, lattice backing and service gantries betraying its true scale

items.name: wind-farm-offshore
items.text: an offshore wind farm marching to the horizon, blades stopped at differing clock angles, sea glinting between the towers

items.name: dam-curve
items.text: a colossal arch dam curved into its gorge, spillway stains streaking the concrete face, a hairline service road along the crest

items.name: ruined-abbey
items.text: a roofless ruined abbey, bare gothic arches framing racing clouds, fallen window tracery half-buried in mown grass

items.name: torii-corridor
items.text: a corridor of a thousand vermilion torii winding uphill, lacquered posts receding to a bright vanishing point

items.name: cooling-towers
items.text: paired hyperbolic cooling towers, concrete shells thin as eggshell at the waist, one soft plume drifting off a rim

items.name: geodesic-dome
items.text: a geodesic dome, triangulated struts and hub nodes resolving into a perfect slice of sphere against open sky

items.name: victorian-pier
items.text: a Victorian pleasure pier walking out to sea on barnacled cast-iron legs, a filigree pavilion at the far end

items.name: grain-silos
items.text: a rank of concrete grain silos, bare cylinders stepping forward in raking light, conveyor gantries bridging the tops

items.name: motorway-interchange
items.text: a stacked motorway interchange, ribbons of roadway looping over one another on slender piers, lane paint drawing white geometry through the knot, the top deck laying its curved shadow across the levels below

items.name: victorian-train-shed
items.text: a Victorian railway train shed, one enormous arched span of wrought iron and glass over the platforms, smoke-blackened brick flanks, light falling in latticed sheets through the roof grid

items.name: cable-stayed-fan
items.text: a cable-stayed bridge, stays fanning from a single needle pylon like rigging, the deck drawing one taut line across the river
